items.title: Winner of France's top literary prize admits using AI for novel
items.excerpt: A day after winning the 2026 Prix Goncourt, Philippe Jaenada said on France Inter that he used AI while writing 'L'Inconnue du quai de Javel', reopening the debate over AI in literary fiction weeks after Thélyson Orélien was dropped from the prize list.
items.rationale: Biggest fresh event of the pool: the Goncourt winner himself disclosed AI use, a new case distinct from the Prix Pascal launch and the Orélien scandal.

items.title: Readwise takes on Amazon's Kindle and Goodreads with its new app for book lovers
items.excerpt: Readwise Books combines an e-book store, reading tracker and publisher-permitted AI features (session recaps, lookups, translation, location-aware Q&A) plus a public API and MCP server for AI agents.
items.rationale: New product launch: an e-book store and reader with publisher-permitted AI features and an MCP server, a concrete alternative to Kindle.

items.title: Oxford University Press Tests Licensing Content to ChatGPT
items.excerpt: A three-month pilot lets students and researchers search licensed OUP content inside ChatGPT Edu, run with Harvard Library, Wharton and the University of Oxford.
items.rationale: New licensing pilot: OUP content searchable inside ChatGPT Edu at Harvard, Wharton and Oxford; a different publisher and deal from the Meridian gateway card.

items.title: 30분이면 책 한 권 교정·교열 끝···북엔드, AI로 출판 혁신 '에디토리얼'로 글로벌 시장 도전
items.excerpt: 대덕 출판사 북엔드가 교정·교열 시간을 2주에서 30분으로 줄인 AI 도서 편집 서비스 '에디토리얼'을 내놓고 작가 문체를 살리는 편집으로 해외 시장에 나섰다.
items.rationale: Shipped tool: an AI copy-editing service that cuts proofreading from two weeks to 30 minutes; directly changes editorial workflow.

items.title: “다음 편 빨리 내놔”⋯웹툰 팬이 만든 AI 실사화에 230만명 몰렸다
items.excerpt: 네이버웹툰 '제물 투표'를 AI로 실사화한 팬 영상이 유튜브 공개 한 달 반 만에 230만 회를 넘기며 AI 2차 창작의 저작권 기준 논의가 커지고 있다.
items.rationale: Concrete new case: a fan-made AI live-action adaptation of a Naver Webtoon hit 2.3M views, forcing the question of copyright rules for AI derivative works.
